searchText: FWIW, I raised the issue in <#745077610685661265> right before this was presented in ACD and I believe this channel has been anyway the venue for governance discussions for a while now. I would much rather have this be the place of governance discussions than either - Twitter - Small Corridors or closed Telegram/Signal channels - Behind some restaurant doors during meetings The three of which seem to be the top places before this one. So yes, I'm happy if this server becomes a place for governance outside of Twitter, I'd just keep every single discussion on it on a single channel that can be ignored (as the message above perhaps suggest) instead of having it spread across multiple channels Thanks <@755590043632140352> , totally agree Eth Magicians is best suited for longer form thoughtful discussion, so IMHO it is the better venue for should we/shouldn't we.

FWIW, I raised the issue in <#745077610685661265> right before this was presented in ACD and I believe this channel has been anyway the venue for governance discussions for a while now.  I would much rather have this be the place of governance discussions than either 

- Twitter
- Small Corridors or closed Telegram/Signal channels

The three of which seem to be the top places before this one.
